description: Pistes cyclables is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commune de Saint-Paul-lès-Dax. This dataset lists the cycle paths on the territory of the city of Saint-Paul-lès-Dax. It consists of a list of geo-localised points and/or polygons. The file formats offered are geographical formats of the type GEOJSON and SHAPEFILE. Coverage: Commune de Saint-Paul-lès-Dax. The portal shows the English title as "Bike paths" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Commune de Saint-Paul-lès-Dax. Its keywords include mobilite, liaison-douce, voie-verte, deplacement, piste-cyclable, voirie. The listing shows 3 download or service links in PDF, ZIP, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2019-06-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
